title: Talented artist Twonbeatz delivers a new single, "I'm Her"
htmlContent:
Twonbeatz is a multi-talented singer, producer, and producer born and raised in Georgia. Though it is equally tough to survive among the industry's more prominent personalities who have set the bar high with incredible accomplishments, several people, including Twonbeatz, are proving why they are a mainstay in the music world. The Grammy award-winning producer does not disappoint in releasing his recent track, "Im Her."

Twonbeatz, in his recent song "I'm Her," talks about women's empowerment. Here, The lyrics are relatable and honest in every line that makes it connect to the listener, and it's all delivered with flair and conviction to make it a remarkable story for music lovers everywhere.
